assets.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished production art-direction reference for an ORIGINAL cheerful garden lane-defense video game for a small handheld screen. Landscape 4:3 game composition, full-bleed rectangular viewport. The screenshot should FEEL LIKE A GAME, no app dashboard, no flat pill-button menu, no web cards. A warmly painted storybook garden, chunky expressive original cartoon characters, confident dark olive outlines, simple large shapes, vibrant mint and lime foliage, apricot and golden sunlight, subtle brush texture, readable at 320x240. Center a large lush 9-column by 5-row lawn seen nearly top-down, very subtle alternating grass patches. A winding cobbled path on left and soft wildflower bushes around the perimeter. Small carved pale-wood seed tray along top, four irregular seed packets with character portraits, a round amber water-drop resource medallion on left and small pause acorn on right. Tiny wood-and-vine wave gauge in lower right, little garden trowel lower left. No permanent instructions. Original defenders facing right: a periwinkle blue bellflower cradling a luminous amber dew droplet on a curled stem; a squat coral-red three-petaled flower with cream cheeks casting golden seeds, NOT a tubular peashooter; a layered purple artichoke rosette with tiny eyes and a curled green leafy shield, NOT a walnut; a mint-green four-blade pinwheel flower launching leaf boomerangs. Original enemies facing left: a soot-navy fuzzy dust imp with two twig ears, a tan stitched pouch and small amber eyes, no zombie clothing; a copper-orange round beetle with teal wing casings, small goggles and springy feet. Show a natural playable arrangement, only a few units in each row. Top space contains an original chunky hand-lettered Chinese title '露芽守卫' in a small wooden emblem. No other text except small resource numerals. This is original art: avoid any actual Plants vs Zombies characters, likenesses, logos, recognizable seed cards, house designs, UI assets or zombie designs. Borrow only broad cheerful hand-painted casual strategy mood and lane-defense readability. Make this commercially polished and charming, not muddy, pixel art, vector flat, realistic or 3D plastic.
